nodes.name: File added to input folder
nodes.notes: Folder is fixed here because a trigger cannot read settings. Production: /files/input.

nodes.name: Every 15 minutes
nodes.notes: Safety net: picks up files that arrived while n8n was stopped, and retries failed or held cases.

nodes.name: Run now
nodes.notes: Addition to the design (interfaces.md): POST /webhook/harsll-run-now starts a run at once. Local only; review before production.

nodes.name: Load settings
nodes.notes: Loaded once per run and passed on. Points at HARSLL – Settings.

nodes.name: Settings complete?
nodes.notes: Fails loudly, before the lock is taken, if a setting the Dispatcher needs is missing or empty (an expression error would otherwise just give null).

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'HARSLL settings are incomplete. Missing or empty: ' + (((s) => s ? ['casesTableId','batchesTableId','lockTableId','performerWorkflowId','inputFolder','archiveFolder','rejectedFolder','reportsFolder','summaryEmailTo','summaryEmailFrom'].filter(k => typeof s[k] !== 'string' || s[k] === '').concat(Array.isArray(s.requiredColumns) && s.requiredColumns.length ? [] : ['requiredColumns']).concat(['maxAttempts','stuckMinutes','lockStaleMinutes','fileSettleSeconds','maxFileReadAttempts'].filter(k => !(Number(s[k]) > 0))) : ['settings'])($json.settings) || ['settings']).join(', ') }}

nodes.name: Wait for the file to settle
Take the lock
nodes.notes: Takes the lock only if it is free or has not been refreshed for lockStaleMinutes. One update, so only one run can win.

nodes.name: End: another run has the lock
nodes.notes: The running pass or the next timer handles any new file.

nodes.name: List settled spreadsheets
nodes.notes: One fixed command with no file names in it: .xlsx files unchanged for at least a minute, skipping Excel temporary files (~$...). Names are separated by NUL characters.

nodes.name: Note file details
nodes.notes: batchId = <yyyy-MM-ddTHH-mm-ss>_<file name>, local time.

nodes.name: File name safe?
nodes.notes: Only letters, numbers, spaces and _ - . ( ), ending .xlsx. Unsafe names never reach a command.

parameters.subject: HARSLL: please rename a spreadsheet
parameters.text:
=A spreadsheet in the HARSLL input folder has a name the automation will not open, so it has been left where it is.

File: {{ $('Note file details').first().json.fileName }}

Please rename it using only letters, numbers, spaces and these characters: _ - . ( )
The name must end in .xlsx. It will be picked up automatically once renamed.

This is the only email about this file.

nodes.name: Read the spreadsheet
nodes.notes: Literal brackets on, so a name like 'changes (1).xlsx' is not read as a pattern.

nodes.name: Extract the rows
nodes.notes: Header row on; Include Empty Cells on, so an empty column is not mistaken for a missing one. A file that cannot be read gives one item with an error field.

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ JSON.stringify({ readFailed: $('Extract the rows').all().some(i => i.json.error !== undefined && Object.keys(i.json).length === 1), readError: String($('Extract the rows').first().json.error ?? ''), rowCount: $('Extract the rows').all().filter(i => Object.keys(i.json).length > 0 && !(i.json.error !== undefined && Object.keys(i.json).length === 1)).length, missingColumns: $('Load settings').first().json.settings.requiredColumns.filter(c => !Object.keys($('Extract the rows').first().json).includes(c)) }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ readAttempts: (Number($('Find earlier failed reads').first().json.readAttempts) || 0) + 1, batchId: $('Find earlier failed reads').first().json.batchId || $('Note file details').first().json.batchId, rowCount: 0, reason: 'The file could not be opened as a spreadsheet on ' + ((Number($('Find earlier failed reads').first().json.readAttempts) || 0) + 1) + ' runs. Technical detail: ' + $('Check the file').first().json.readError }) }}

nodes.name: Record unreadable file
nodes.notes: Left in the input folder for the next run.

value.receivedAt: ={{ $('Find earlier failed reads').first().json.receivedAt ? $('Find earlier failed reads').first().json.receivedAt : $now.toISO() }}

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ JSON.stringify({ batchId: $('Find earlier failed reads').first().json.batchId || $('Note file details').first().json.batchId, readAttempts: Number($('Find earlier failed reads').first().json.readAttempts) || 0, rowCount: $json.rowCount, reason: $json.rowCount === 0 ? 'The file is empty or has no rows of changes under its header row.' : 'The file is missing these columns: ' + $json.missingColumns.join(', ') + '.' }) }}

nodes.name: Move file to rejected
nodes.notes: Only reached for safe names, so the quoted name cannot inject a command. If the move fails, the file stays for the next run and no email is sent.

value.receivedAt: ={{ $('Find earlier failed reads').first().json.receivedAt ? $('Find earlier failed reads').first().json.receivedAt : $now.toISO() }}

parameters.subject: =HARSLL: spreadsheet rejected – {{ $('Note file details').first().json.fileName }}

nodes.name: Tidy rows
nodes.notes: Why Code: three date forms with validation and rounding; keys built with the shared normalise() rule.

nodes.name: Link rows of the same tenancy
nodes.notes: Why Code: needs all rows of the file at once to group them (design: Rows for the same tenancy).

nodes.name: Keep only new case keys
nodes.notes: Runs first (top branch): new case keys are inserted before the batch is recorded and the file archived.

nodes.name: Find the earlier case
nodes.notes: Second branch: rows whose case key is already recorded. Only a referred case is reopened; updated, duplicate, new, failed and in_progress cases are left alone.

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ JSON.stringify({ id: $json.id, oldStatus: $json.status, oldReasonCode: $json.reasonCode || '', oldBatchId: $json.batchId || '', submissions: Number($json.submissions || 1), row: $('Link rows of the same tenancy').all().map(i => i.json).find(r => r.caseKey === $json.caseKey) }) }}

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'Could not match a recorded case to its row in the new file (case ' + $json.id + '). Nothing was reopened.' }}

nodes.name: Reopen case in this batch
nodes.notes: Reopened in the new file's batch with the new row's details; earlier result kept in previousResult.

nodes.name: Record the batch
nodes.notes: Bottom branch, so it runs after the cases are recorded. Updates the file's earlier 'unreadable' record if there is one.

nodes.name: Move file to archive
nodes.notes: mv with the name in single quotes; only reached for safe names. Archived as <yyyy-MM-ddTHH-mm-ss>_<name>.

nodes.name: Find stuck cases with no tries left
nodes.notes: Branch 1 of 4 (runs first).

value.reasonText: Processing stopped unexpectedly and the tries ran out
value.errorDetail: ={{ 'Stuck in progress for more than ' + $('Load settings').first().json.settings.stuckMinutes + ' minutes after ' + $json.attempts + ' tries' }}

nodes.name: Find unfinished cases
nodes.notes: Branch 2 of 4.

nodes.name: Ready to process now?
nodes.notes: new; failed with tries left; in_progress for longer than stuckMinutes with tries left.

conditions.leftValue: ={{ $json.status === 'new' || ($json.status === 'failed' && Number($json.attempts) < Number($('Load settings').first().json.settings.maxAttempts)) || ($json.status === 'in_progress' && Number($json.attempts) < Number($('Load settings').first().json.settings.maxAttempts) && (!$json.lastAttemptAt || new Date($json.lastAttemptAt).getTime() < $now.minus($('Load settings').first().json.settings.stuckMinutes, 'minutes').toMillis())) }}

nodes.name: Put cases in order
nodes.notes: Date order; on the same date move-outs before move-ins; then batch, then row.

nodes.name: Get every case for this account
Check for an earlier unfinished case
nodes.notes: Why Code: compares this case's place in the processing order with every other case for the account, as they are now. Joint rows thereby wait for their lead row.

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ JSON.stringify({ caseId: $json.caseId, expectedStatus: $json.expectedStatus, expectedAttempts: $json.expectedAttempts, settings: $('Load settings').first().json.settings }) }}

nodes.name: Run the Performer
nodes.notes: One case at a time, waiting for each; carries on if it errors.

nodes.name: Stop: the lock was lost
nodes.notes: Another run took over a lock this run had not refreshed in time. Stop processing; that run carries on.

nodes.name: Check the lock before reporting
nodes.notes: Branch 3 of 4. Reports only if this run still holds the lock, so a summary is never sent twice.

nodes.name: Still hold the lock for reporting?
Find batches waiting for a summary
Build the summary and worklist
nodes.notes: Why Code: counts by status, outcome and reason with fixed plain-English wording, plus the worklist rows, from all of a batch's cases at once. The email holds counts only.

nodes.name: Release the lock
nodes.notes: Branch 4 of 4 (runs last). Only releases the lock if this run still holds it.
